summary: Lionheart Holdings, a blank-check SPAC, disclosed via 8-K that it executed a non-binding letter of intent with Keo Capital AB (on behalf of KEO Energy) for a potential business combination. No financial terms, stake, or price per share were provided. The transaction remains subject to due diligence, definitive agreement negotiation, board/equity holder approvals, and regulatory clearance. No board recommendation or advisors named. The deal carries high execution risk given the preliminary stage; any definitive agreement would trigger a proxy statement/registration statement. Watch for subsequent filings confirming or terminating negotiations.
